decision.what: The gear and 'More' (⋯) buttons the owner meant are not in Widget.js at all — Widget.js just calls ext/Chat/Composer.js's composer(), which builds both buttons (⋯ toggled a small popover with Dictate's engine/status info; the gear toggled Mic.js's settings_panel()). Merged them in Composer.js/Mic.js/Chat.css instead: ONE ⚙ button now opens ONE full-screen panel (position:fixed, inset:0 — same shape as ext/Chat/Drill.js's .chatbox-drill) holding both the engine/status info block and the settings grid. This fixes every surface that uses composer() at once (ChatPanel, AI2, the Dictate Widget) — CLAUDE.md law 6 — instead of forking a second copy inside Widget.js.
decision.alternative: could have faked a merge inside Widget.js alone, but the real buttons live in Composer.js/Mic.js, so that would not have actually merged anything for any surface. Also updated ext/Chat/readme.md and ux/Dictate/readme.md so the docs describe the new one-button full-screen menu instead of the old two popovers.
